description: This is a Swift source file defining a SwiftUI view component called DebugSettings. It provides debugging tools and status displays for an application, including sections for app info, gateway controls, logs, port diagnostics, file paths, quick actions, and Canvas integration. The file includes numerous state properties, UI layout code, and functions for performing debugging actions like port checks, process kills, file operations, and Canvas evaluations.

classes.name: PlainSettingsGroupBoxStyle
classes.description: Custom SwiftUI style for grouping settings UI elements with a caption.

methods.name: runPortCheck
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous check of gateway port status, updating port reports.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel to the gateway, then re-runs port check.

methods.name: requestKill
methods.description: Requests to kill a process listener, either directly or via user confirmation.

methods.name: killConfirmed
methods.description: Confirms and executes a process kill, updating status based on result.

methods.name: chooseCatalogFile
methods.description: Opens a file dialog for selecting a models.generated.ts file and reloads models.

methods.name: reloadModels
methods.description: Asynchronously loads model definitions from the catalog path.

methods.name: sendVoiceDebug
methods.description: Sends a debug voice message asynchronously, updating UI status.

methods.name: revealApp
methods.description: Reveals the application bundle in Finder.

methods.name: saveRelayRoot
methods.description: Saves the current gateway root path to the GatewayProcessManager.

methods.name: loadSessionStorePath
methods.description: Loads the session store path from configuration data.

methods.name: saveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Saves the session store path to configuration data.

methods.name: canvasWriteSamplePage
methods.description: Creates an example HTML page in Canvas session directory and displays it.

methods.name: canvasEval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript in the Canvas session context.

methods.name: canvasSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the Canvas session.
